column3: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column2: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column3:
implementing  diverse  programmes  for 
the
propagation of Buddhism, Catholicism, Hinduism
and Islam among the people and extending as much
support  as  possible  for  their  promotion  and
establishing  societies  and  organizations  with  the
participation  of  the  devotees  of  such  religious
centers  with  a  view  to  building  a  virtuous  and
peaceful society valuing time honored customs and
rituals;
to  encourage  farmers  engaged  in  traditional  and
export  agricultural  activities    and  to  carry  out
various awareness programmes for them;
providing  relief  and  welfare  services  in  natural
disasters, distress and unexpected incidents;
to provide or arrange to provide vocational training
and assistance to disadvantaged young persons to
engage  in  self-employment  or  to  secure  other
employment;
to engage in any industry or trade or any export or
import  business  and  to  aid  or  assist  persons  to
commence and operate agricultural, industrial and
commercial  ventures  and  to  undertake  training
programmes  and  extension  of  services  and  to
organize  propaganda  activities  relating  to  the
transfer of technology;
setting  up  welfare  insurance  schemes  for  the
members of the Foundation;
to do all other things necessary or expedient for the
carrying out of the objects of the Corporation; and
to liaise and co-ordinate with other local and foreign
institutions which have similar objects.
